scope: Independent offline audit of the completed weak-damping 129-frame GPU peak window, its same-time strong-damping control and two shared weak-short states. Only this review and the matching new review note were written. No solver, worker, notifier, Git operation, production/formal edit or change to retained evidence was performed.

provenance_audit.scope: All explicit bound file entries in the current status/run/check/inputs/completion and the bound Release build record, including current input, program, source, runtime and native output entries. Unrelated historical JSON trees were not recursively opened.
provenance_audit.ownership_check: No recorded owned PID and no DualSPHysics/Python process tagged cryer_damp_peak_r1 was alive at review. No process was stopped by the reviewer; no unrelated process command lines were retained.

native_audit.safety_method: Original inspect() guards were reapplied to every new and control native frame: finite state, positive density, no exclusions, elastic state, saved precision flags, real inward load, actual FSType2/3 drainage, mechanical-step and pore-step limits. Initial mass/h, fixed material IDs, radius, exact saved times and steps were separately rechecked. Reuse of the original guard is not a separately derived physical stability proof.

summary_and_effect_recalculation.method: Native summary and same-time option effects were recomputed. Regional radial stress was independently expanded from diagonal and shear tensor entries. Numeric summary comparisons allowed only 1e-10+1e-12*abs(value) machine-rounding tolerance; this is not a changed physical gate. Stored effects agreed exactly.
summary_and_effect_recalculation.region_definition: Fixed initial center ball r0<=dp+1e-12; interior r0<R-2h; outer shell r0>=R-2h. Center is a subset of interior. Only interior and outer shell partition all soil IDs.
summary_and_effect_recalculation.stress_definition: Effective stress is tensile-positive. Total compressive mean=-trace(sigma_effective)/3+p; radial compression=-e0^T*sigma_effective*e0+p, using each fixed initial radial direction. Settlement is mean(r0-r)*1000 mm, not a projected vector displacement.
summary_and_effect_recalculation.effect_definition: Same native IDs at exactly equal actual times. Pressure RMS and six-component total-stress RMS are option differences, not half-step errors, cross-backend bounds or theory errors.

shared_sample_exception: Only dterror_s was excluded from cross-cadence byte equality. It is an interval statistic; both unchanged original dterror<=1e-14-s guards were independently applied. Actual times, saved steps and all other 34 native columns were exact. No physical-field or clock-alignment exception was allowed.

dense_short_observer_caveat.source: The separately retained and previously reviewed five-sample weak-short coarse/half summary
dense_short_observer_caveat.consequence: The 129-frame sampled maximum is not the maximum over the combined observed startup data and is not a continuous-time maximum.

verified_sampled_outcomes.mandel_window_rule: All saved samples Tv>=0.005, starting Part10 at t=0.0048828125 s, through the bounded final time. Startup samples remain in the unfiltered all-sample comparison.

limitations: The only effective input difference is the dimensionless kinematic-damping coefficient 0.02 to 0.00004 under the existing damping formula. This is a bounded parameter sensitivity test, not a complete reproduction of the paper.

Both normal completion and original saved-state safety are confirmed, but only one timestep was used throughout this peak window. Earlier independent half-step evidence covers the short startup window, not all 129 peak-window samples.
The two exact shared states are not an entire dense prefix or an exact restart proof. No new full/peak half-step gate was evaluated or waived.

All maxima are among stated saved samples. The dense short window already records a higher startup center pressure than the coarse-cadence peak window, so neither is presented as a continuous-time extremum.

The 18-ID native center observer lies at finite initial radius r0/R=0.05, not at the analytical point center. Native p0=0 differs from the quasi-static theoretical t0+ limit q. These observations constrain interpretation of theory gaps.

Reducing damping changes the startup response more than the later declared Mandel window. The roughly 3.25-Pa later peak change does not establish that damping explains the hundreds-of-Pa point-reference gap.

The final raw-load radial resultant and affine-work ratios remain about 1.09834 and 1.06435 relative to geometric references; their near equality between damping options is not a load-consistency correction or physical acceptance.

No formal root output, physical equation, precision state, mass, geometry, traction, gradient operator or threshold was changed by this review. No Git backup was performed by the reviewer; raw BI4 and executables are not implicitly cloud backed.
